_comment: Documented divergences of the TS event surface against the event_stream corpus. Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that now passes is red (stale baseline). The TS event coverage is partial: middleware-bus envelopes carry a smaller field set than the reference SecurityEvent, several handler seams emit no event yet, and the envelope comparison records the absent fields. Entries name the TS source responsible.

cases.event_stream/evt_penetration_attempt_blo: envelope field handler_name is not observable: SecurityEventBus.sendMiddlewareEvent (core/events/event-bus.ts) carries no handler_name
cases.event_stream/evt_penetration_attempt_pas: envelope field handler_name is not observable: SecurityEventBus.sendMiddlewareEvent (core/events/event-bus.ts) carries no handler_name; event 0 field metadata: want {"request_count":1,"passive_mode":true,"trigger_info":"Request body: Value matched pattern '<script[^>]*>[^<]*<\\/script\\s*>'"}, got {"trigger_info":"Request body: Value matched pattern '<script[^>]*>[^<]*<\\/script\\s*>'","request_count":1}
cases.event_stream/evt_ip_blocked_global_black: envelope field handler_name is not observable: SecurityEventBus.sendMiddlewareEvent (core/events/event-bus.ts) carries no handler_name; event 0 field metadata: want {"ip_address":"203.0.113.11","filter_type":"global"}, got {}
cases.event_stream/evt_ip_banned_then_blocked: event 0 field action_taken: want "banned", got "ip_banned"; envelope field handler_name is not observable: SecurityEventBus.sendMiddlewareEvent (core/events/event-bus.ts) carries no handler_name; event 0 field metadata: want {"duration":3600}, got {"duration":3600,"expires_at":1790861365.696}; event 1 field metadata: want {"ip_address":"203.0.113.12","filter_type":"banned"}, got {}
cases.event_stream/evt_ip_ban_failed_escalatio: no ip_ban_failed escalation telemetry in the TS engine (handlers/ip-ban.ts, core/checks/helpers.ts resolveThresholdBan)
cases.event_stream/evt_ip_unbanned: event 0 field action_taken: want "banned", got "ip_banned"; envelope field handler_name is not observable: SecurityEventBus.sendMiddlewareEvent (core/events/event-bus.ts) carries no handler_name; event 0 field metadata: want {"duration":3600}, got {"duration":3600,"expires_at":1790861365.697}; event 1 field action_taken: want "unbanned", got "ip_unbanned"; event 1 field reason: want "dynamic_rule_whitelist", got "Manual unban"; event 1 field metadata not observable in the TS envelope (expected {"action":"unban"})
cases.event_stream/evt_cloud_blocked_provider: event 0 field reason: want "IP belongs to blocked cloud provider: AWS", got "Cloud provider IP 203.0.113.10 detected"; event 0 field endpoint: want null, got "/api"; event 0 field method: want null, got "GET"; envelope field handler_name is not observable: SecurityEventBus.sendMiddlewareEvent (core/events/event-bus.ts) carries no handler_name; event 0 field metadata: want {"cloud_provider":"AWS","network":"203.0.113.0/24"}, got {"blocked_providers":["AWS"]}; event 1 field decorator_type not observable in the TS envelope (expected "block_clouds")

cases.event_stream/evt_decorator_violation_aut: event 0 field decorator_type not observable in the TS envelope (expected "authentication"); envelope field handler_name is not observable: SecurityEventBus.sendMiddlewareEvent (core/events/event-bus.ts) carries no handler_name
